Stage.LogText: {=shdw_q1_s1_log}Your clan's name has started to be heard around here. A merchant named {GorevVeren_Link} in {HedefSehir_Link} wants to see you. It seems their caravans have been mysteriously disappearing lately.
{=shdw_q1_s2_log}You spoke with the merchant {GorevVeren_Link} and agreed to track down the bandits attacking their caravans. Find the Smuggler Caravan on the map and defeat them.
{=shdw_q1_s3_log}You destroyed the caravan and obtained the Encrypted Ledger. Now you must head to the back alleys of {HedefSehir_Link} and confront the Gang Leader {KacakciLideri_Link}.
{=shdw_q1_s4_pusu_log}You defied the gang leader. They threatened you and warned that the outside of the city is dangerous. Be prepared for an ambush as soon as you leave the settlement.
{=shdw_q1_s5_savas_log}The gang's assassins have ambushed you outside the city! Defeat them to secure the merchant's routes.
{=shdw_q1_s4_santaj_log}You made a deal with the gang leader. Now go back to the merchant {GorevVeren_Link} and force them to pay tribute to the gang, while you take your own hefty cut.
{=shdw_q1_s5a_log}You ignored the whispers of the shadows and brought justice. The caravan routes are safer now, but the underworld has marked your name.
{=shdw_q1_s5b_log}The gleam of gold covered the color of blood. You forced the merchant into submission and became a partner of the shadows. The underworld routes are now under your protection.

DialogNode.Text: {=shdw_q1_dlg2}My caravans... Someone is attacking them! Bandits are stealing my goods, but this is no ordinary robbery; it's as if they know our routes. Please find them and finish them off.
{=shdw_q1_dlg3}I'll track down your caravans. Have my gold ready.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_sorgu_guard}Aren't the town guards meant to protect the trade routes? Why are the watch turning a blind eye?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_sorgu_tehdit}If you are using me for some dirty mercantile scheme, this market will be your grave. Who are you really fighting?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_pay}Merchants always have woes. What is my share in this? Is it worth my blade?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_guard_cevap}The watch commanders receive silver-stuffed pouches each month. Beyond the city gates, Calradia knows only the law of steel. These raiders are not common scum; they strike with military precision.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_tehdit_cevap}Peace, warrior! I swear by the heavens I speak true. I am no saint, but these raiders strike with military discipline, and my livelihood is crumbling!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_pazarlik_cevap}I pay handsomely for results! Retrieve my ledger and protect my enterprise, and a purse brimming with five thousand denars shall be yours.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_sorgu_cargo}What cargo was the caravan carrying, and where do these cutthroats make their camp?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_sorgu_suspect}Do you suspect anyone in particular? A rival merchant guild, or the alley gangs?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_cargo_cevap}Concealed within bolts of imported silk was an encrypted ledger recording all black-market debts and discreet transactions in the city! If that ledger falls into enemy hands, my head is forfeit. The raiders were last sighted holding the pass outside the city.

{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_suspect_cevap}The back-alley syndicate! Their gang master has been extorting ruinous protection coin from my warehouses. When I refused their latest demands, my caravans began vanishing into thin air.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_sorgu_moral}An encrypted ledger of black-market debts? Sounds like your hands are just as dirty as the raiders. Why should I fight your private war?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_sorgu_taktik}Holding the rocky pass outside the city gives them the tactical advantage. How many blades do they command?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_moral_cevap}In Calradia, every merchant who wants to survive must dance with the shadows! If you bring back that ledger and purge the pass, 5,000 denars in pure silver is yours. Refuse, and the gang rules the trade routes!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_taktik_cevap}Around two dozen well-armed deserters and cutthroats. Strike them hard before they slip into the deep hills with my cargo!
{=shdw_q1_dlg3}I'll track down your caravans. Have my gold ready.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_kabul_adalet}I will hunt down those raiders for the safety of the roads, merchant. But once I hold that ledger, we will have words about your transactions.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_kervan1}What do you want, stranger? Turn back before things get ugly!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_kervan2}I am here for the stolen goods and the merchant's ledger. Draw your steel!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_kervan_sorgu}Whose orders are you carrying out? Whose seal is stamped on those contraband crates?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_kervan_tehdit}If you lie to me, this sand will be your grave. Whose orders are you carrying out?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_kervan_sorgu_c}(Laughs) A mercenary dog sent by that coward merchant! That ledger belongs to the masters of the back alleys now. If you want it, bleed for it!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_kervan_tehdit_c}(Laughs) Big words for someone outnumbered! You will rot in the dirt before we reveal our masters! Cut them down!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_kervan_sorgu2}The back-alley syndicate? So you admit you're running smuggled contraband for the city gang leader?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_kervan_sorgu2_c}We take orders from {KacakciLideri_Link}! You won't leave this valley alive to tell anyone! Kill them!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_pusu_saldir}Come on then, gang scum! Taste my steel!

{=shdw_q1_cete_turn1}(Pushes his goblet aside and studies you cold-eyed) Did you think you could stroll into my den unchecked, stranger? You may have bypassed my lookouts, but whether you leave this cellar breathing remains to be seen. Speak, before my steel tastes your throat.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_threat}If you lie to me, this tavern will be your tomb. I butchered your caravan dogs and took this encrypted ledger. Who is behind you?
{=shdw_q1_dlg4}I found the dogs plundering the caravans and seized this encrypted ledger. You're no common bandit, who is behind this?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_cunning}I routed your caravan and hold your encrypted ledger. I want to know who pulls the strings in this city before I decide whose side I am on.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=shdw_q1_dlg5}(Laughs) You're just a fool who only knows how to swing a sword. That ledger is mine, and the innocent man you think is a merchant is actually a greedy bastard who stopped paying us tribute to monopolize the market.

{=shdw_q1_dlg5}(Laughs) You're just a fool who only knows how to swing a sword. That ledger is mine, and the innocent man you think is a merchant is actually a greedy bastard who stopped paying us tribute to monopolize the market.

{=shdw_q1_dlg5}(Laughs) You're just a fool who only knows how to swing a sword. That ledger is mine, and the innocent man you think is a merchant is actually a greedy bastard who stopped paying us tribute to monopolize the market.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_lore}How do the town guards and nobility overlook this smuggling? How deep does this syndicate run?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_pay}What is my share in this dark business? I do not dirty my hands without substantial coin.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_lore_c}Nobles feast on untaxed wine while their castellans pocket our silver. The law in Calradia is merely a whip cracked across the backs of the weak. Those with gold make the rules, and the rest obey.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_pay_c}Ten thousand denars from the merchant's vaults. Squeeze him dry and half is yours. Now, are you in or do you wish to test my steel?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_teklif_sor}A ruthless system, but profitable. What exact proposition are you putting on the table?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_teklif_pratik}Spare me the grand speeches. How do you propose we deal with the merchant?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=shdw_q1_dlg6}Instead of causing me so much trouble, let's make a deal. Eliminate that merchant, and I'll give you a cut. The city streets are ours, and you'll profit too.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_phil}They say those who seek mercy in the shadows become food for jackals... But what if I refuse to bow to either you or the merchant?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_sinir}You talk of sharing profits, but extortion and blade-work always spill blood. What happens if the merchant calls the town guard?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_guvence}Five thousand denars is tempting, but what guarantees do I have that your assassins won't slip a dagger between my ribs once the coin is collected?
{=shdw_q1_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_phil_c}(Resting his hand on his pommel) Then the unwritten laws of these alleys shall crush you beneath our boots, stranger. You either ally with gold or bleed under cold steel. Choose now!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_sinir_c}The guards? I already told you, the guards eat from our hand. Squeeze him hard enough and he won't dare whisper a word to the watch. Choose now!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_cete_guvence_c}My word is the only law in these alleys! A dead partner brings no gold, but a loyal one keeps the routes flowing. Make your decision, stranger!
{=shdw_q1_dlg7}You can't escape justice. I will see you hang.
{=shdw_q1_dlg8}I am a noble, I don't do dirty work like assassinations. But pay me a hefty cut, and I'll force the merchant to pay you your tribute.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_tehdit}Is that so? The outside of the city can be very dangerous these days. Watch your back on the roads, fool.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_anlasma}Now you are talking like a true noble. Go convince him to pay up, and the underworld routes will welcome you.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_tuccar_santaj_intro}You have returned! Tell me, did you deal with the bandits? Are my goods and caravans safe?
{=shdw_q1_dlg9}Your hands are tied, merchant. Pay the gang their tribute and give me my cut, or I will let them butcher you.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_kurnaz}I read that encrypted ledger, my friend. Your hands are just as dirty as the gang's. Drop the innocent act and pay our share, or watch your empire burn.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_santaj_direnis}You were supposed to protect me! Do you realize what will happen to this city's trade if the syndicate bleeds my warehouses dry? I'll call the magistrate!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_t_santaj_baski}The magistrate is in the syndicate's pocket, and this ledger proves your own guilt. Hand over the gold now, or my blade will do the talking.
{=shdw_q1_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=shdw_q1_dlg10}You... you are worse than them! Fine, take the gold. I have no choice. Leave me alone!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_pusu2}So you think crossing {KacakciLideri_Link} is a good idea? Prepare to die! We will send you and that talkative merchant to your ancestors!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_pusu_saldir}Come on then, gang scum! Taste my steel!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_pusu_gozdagi}If you lie to me or think you can frighten me, this field will be your grave! Flee before I cut you all down!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_pusu_yanit_c}Empty threats from a dead man walking! Kill them all!
{=shdw_q1_dlg_pusu_saldir}Come on then, gang scum! Taste my steel!
